Use case: stylized-concept. Create a proposal sheet for UMBRAL retro 1990s first-person shooter. Reference image is STYLE AND HUMAN HANDS reference only; redesign the round weapon completely. Crisp chunky pixel-art, hand-dithered dark metal, no smooth illustration, no photorealism. TWO wide 16:9 FIRST PERSON VIEWPORTS STACKED VERTICALLY on one image, top ready pose, bottom firing pose. Same exact weapon design and scale in both views. Transparent background, no divider, labels, text, scenery, border or UI. Each viewport must be composed like a real FPS screenshot, NOT a sideways product photograph. Most of upper and left viewport is transparent negative space. The weapon's rear receiver enters from BOTTOM RIGHT CORNER (x85%, y90% of each viewport), muzzle points AWAY FROM CAMERA diagonally toward x54%, y49%. Show TOP and INNER LEFT side of the weapon in strong foreshortening. Entire weapon and hands remain within RIGHT HALF of each viewport; do NOT place the weapon in center or point a front muzzle at the viewer. Human right hand grips trigger near bottom right, left hand supports weapon underneath nearer center-right; warm medium-brown skin, charcoal frayed cuffs matching reference. Exactly two hands with plausible grip. Keep 4 percent alpha padding around canvas and between viewports, weapons and all effects do not cross panel bounds. Primary shape language RECTANGULAR, FACETED, INDUSTRIAL with subtle original Mesoamerican-inspired stepped motifs, no copied sacred text. NO spherical central tank, no round ball body, no skull on gun, no centered symmetrical gun.
WEAPON: INCENSARIO DE GUERRA redesigned as a fantasy FLAMETHROWER. Compact ASYMMETRIC trapezoidal dark copper and clay housing, rectangular side-mounted fuel canister with amber liquid slit, ribbed dark hose from rear tank to short narrow angular nozzle, box-shaped perforated heat shield, tiny turquoise ceramic inlays and restrained oxidized copper ornament. Practical readable old industrial shape. The only round details are small bolts and nozzle bore. A small persistent orange pilot light below muzzle. TOP ready: pilot only. BOTTOM firing: EXACT SAME weapon and grip, small opening valve movement, coherent sustained ORANGE FLAME JET with hot pale-yellow core and curling red-orange tongues streams forward away from nozzle toward center-left of viewport, reaching x24%, never occupying upper sky. Strong asymmetry, short heavy silhouette. Flames must clearly originate from muzzle, not from reservoir or hand.
